prompt: Show the 12 months of 2023 with total revenue and total units sold
sql_query:
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', s.Sold_Date) AS month,
    SUM(s.Total_Sale_Value) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(s.Qty_Sold) AS total_units_sold
FROM sales s
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.Sold_Date) = 2023
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.Sold_Date)
ORDER BY month ASC
